prompt: Compose a brief letter declining a job offer you have been considering.
response:
Subject: Job Offer – [Job Title] – [Your Name]

Dear [Hiring Manager's Name],

Thank you so much for offering me the [Job Title] position at [Company Name]. I really appreciate you taking the time to get to know me and share your vision for the team.

After a lot of thought, I've decided to move on and won't be taking the job. It was a tough decision because I thought the role sounded great, but I've decided to take a different path for my career right now.

I want to thank you again for the offer and for the chance to interview.
